system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: production-gke-cluster
  type: container.v1.cluster
  properties:
    zone: us-central1-a
    cluster:
      name: production-gke-cluster
      description: Production GKE Standard cluster
      initialClusterVersion: "1.28"
      network: projects/${PROJECT_ID}/global/networks/default
      subnetwork: projects/${PROJECT_ID}/regions/us-central1/subnetworks/default
      nodePools:
      - name: production-node-pool
        initialNodeCount: 3
        config:
          machineType: e2-standard-4
          diskSizeGb: 100
          diskType: pd-standard
          oauthScopes:
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform
          serviceAccount: ${PROJECT_NUMBER}-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com
          labels:
            environment: production
            workload: general
          tags:
          - production
          shieldedInstanceConfig:
            enableSecureBoot: true
            enableIntegrityMonitoring: true
        management:
          autoUpgrade: true
          autoRepair: true
        autoscaling:
          enabled: true
          minNodeCount: 3
          maxNodeCount: 10
        upgradeSettings:
          maxSurge: 1
          maxUnavailable: 0
      loggingService: logging.googleapis.com/kubernetes
      monitoringService: monitoring.googleapis.com/kubernetes
      networkPolicy:
        enabled: true
        provider: CALICO
      privateClusterConfig:
        enablePrivateNodes: true
        enablePrivateEndpoint: false
        masterIpv4CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/28
      ipAllocationPolicy:
        useIpAliases: true
        createSubnetwork: true
      masterAuthorizedNetworksConfig:
        enabled: true
        cidrBlocks:
        - cidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
          displayName: internal-vpc
      addonsConfig:
        networkPolicyConfig:
          disabled: false
        httpLoadBalancing:
          disabled: false
        horizontalPodAutoscaling:
          disabled: false
        kubernetesDashboard:
          disabled: true
      maintenancePolicy:
        window:
          dailyMaintenanceWindow:
            startTime: "03:00"
      resourceLabels:
        environment: production
        managed-by: deployment-manager
